newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen sideways after Wall St slips.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen sideways after Wall St slips.

text.p: Singapore shares were expected to shuffle sideways on Thursday in the absence of any clear directional hints from overseas markets.
Wall Street's main index, the Dow Jones Industrial Average, fell 26.18 points overnight to 7,357.23. London's FTSE 100 index fell 4.1 points to 4,677.5.
But both falls followed recent strong moves upwards.
"Singapore could go either way today," said one dealer. "My guess is it will stay in the narrow ranges we've been seeing."
The Straits Times Industrials share Index (STII) ended 11.65 points lower at 2,064.36 on Friday.
Singapore's all-share index was up 0.76 at 498.64.
A technical analyst said the STII might be consolidating ahead of a possible move higher next month.
